snippet.title: Woodshire Foragers Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5525210/Woodshire_Foragers/

Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build a thriving village where villagers automate production. Explore colorful lands, battle enemies and bosses, solve puzzles, and conquer dungeons alone or with friends in online co-op.
